title: Green Empress

Flybridge with helm station, seating and overhead canopy
Main saloon with galley and an enclosed wheelhouse with panoramic view

description:
Green Empress is a 16.26 m (53 ft) flybridge motor yacht built by Gulf Craft in the United Arab Emirates, with a white GRP hull and a 4.17 m beam. She is offered for sale in Dubai, where she is registered as a tourist craft licensed to carry 12 passengers, making her well suited to a day charter operation as well as private use.

Power comes from twin Yanmar 6CXM-GTE2 diesel engines of 435 hp each, showing about 1,290 running hours in October 2024, with an Onan marine generator, trim tabs, an electric anchor winch and Furuno radar and GPS.

The main deck combines a bright saloon with sofas, a TV and the galley, opening through a glass sliding door onto a sheltered aft deck with sofa seating and a teak-laid swim platform. The enclosed wheelhouse offers a panoramic view, and the flybridge adds a second helm station, seating and an adjustable overhead canopy.

Below deck, the owner cabin forward has a large double bed, the guest cabin has two single beds, and a separate crew cabin sleeps two. The owner cabin has its own bathroom, and a second toilet serves the guest and crew cabins.

Contact Yacht Research for the full specification and viewing arrangements in Dubai.
